panel.title: File stores
panel.intro: SFTP and FTPS servers with a user and a folder, S3 buckets with an access key, SharePoint and OneDrive libraries through an app registration.
panel.emptyText: Add an SFTP or FTPS server, an S3 bucket or a SharePoint library - e.g. where your software writes its log files. A server's check shows its fingerprint, which you confirm before the password is sent.
panel.note: Check a store after adding it: an SFTP or FTPS server shows its fingerprint first. Only once you confirmed it does the password go to the server. If the server later shows another fingerprint, nothing is sent until you confirm the new one. S3 and SharePoint prove themselves over HTTPS - their check reads the folder at once.

dialog.nameHint: How the store is called, e.g. "Log files"
dialog.nameBlank: Name must not consist of spaces only

typeHint.FTPS: FTP with TLS (AUTH TLS, port 21) - plain FTP is not supported
typeHint.S3: A bucket of Amazon S3 or of a compatible store (e.g. Ceph, Garage, Hetzner, Cloudflare R2), read only
typeHint.SHAREPOINT: A document library of a SharePoint site or a OneDrive, read by an app registration of your Entra ID - read only
typeHint.IMAP: A mailbox folder: every message of the last days is a folder, its attachments and its text the files - read only, nothing is marked as read

dialog.secretKeyHint: Never sent to the store - the requests are signed with it

dialog.libraryHint: The document library's name, e.g. Documents - empty: the site's default one
dialog.directoryIdHint: From the app registration's overview in Entra ID
dialog.clientIdHint: An app with Sites.Selected, granted read on this site only
dialog.clientSecretHint: Goes to Microsoft's login only - a secret expires after two years at the latest

remove.title: Remove "{{name}}"?
remove.message:
What happens with the documents of this source?

Delete: they are deleted with the source - the chat no longer answers from them.
Keep: they stay in the knowledge as uploaded documents, but are no longer kept up to date.

files.title: Files of "{{name}}" not read

files.none: Every file of the source has its document.

files.typeNotSupported: A file type that is not read

run.title: Synchronize "{{name}}" now?

Assign it to a tenant like a model - the tenant chooses it under company knowledge.
